summary: Full backend + frontend E2E test of HIVE. Backend: 22 pytest tests across health/examples/credits/validation/safety, full mission lifecycle (plan->workforce->DAG->parallel->deterministic recovery->verified artifact) and dynamic-workforce comparison across 3 live-AI missions — 22/22 passed, provider='openai' for every mission (no mock fallback observed, 0 fallback warnings in logs). Frontend: dashboard, example fill, HIVE IT launch, mission room live polling to Verified (~55s), artifact dialog, history, workforce, credits pages all functional. 3 frontend polish/UX defects found (React Flow not fit to nodes, artifact modal auto-opens on revisiting completed missions, specialist agents stuck at 'Waiting' after verification). No backend issues in current code; one historical FAILED mission from pre-fix code remains in the DB.

minor.issue: Legacy record present: mission 83a1223c-3345-4147-bf92-17c5c05d4445 status=failed, error="'Agent' object has no attribute 'update'" (oldest mission, produced before the current orchestrator code). Not reproducible with current code (5 fresh missions all verified), but it renders as a red 'Failed' card in Mission History and shows 0 credits. Consider clearing stale demo data and confirming the no-reviewer fallback path in orchestrator._run (line ~99) always passes model_dump() dicts to set_agent.

ui_bugs.issue: fitView only runs on mount when nodes array is still empty (data arrives via async polling), so the graph stays at default scale(2) and 6 of 8 nodes are rendered fully outside the visible pane. Clicking the built-in 'Fit View' control fixes it (scale 0.68, 0/8 offscreen) — proving the RCA. Fix: call useReactFlow().fitView() in an effect keyed on nodes.length, or remount with key={nodes.length}.

Opening an ALREADY-verified mission from Mission History immediately auto-opens the artifact dialog; its overlay blocks all interaction with the graph/feed until the user presses Escape (Playwright normal click on graph controls is intercepted by DialogOverlay). Auto-open should only fire on a live status transition to verified, not on initial load of a finished mission.

After MISSION_VERIFIED, specialist agents remain in 'Waiting' status (only Mission Manager and Reviewer become 'Done') in both the mission room sidebar and /workforce grid — looks like the mission never finished for those agents.

issues: Shows placeholder '—' and 'No usage yet.' for ~1-2s while /api/credits and /api/missions resolve; a skeleton/loading state would avoid the momentary 'empty' impression (data renders correctly: 377 remaining, 123 used across 7 missions).
Radix console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for DialogContent (a11y).
React Flow attribution hidden (Pro-only) console warning.

action_items: MissionGraph: re-run fitView when nodes stream in (currently 6/8 nodes off-screen on load).
MissionRoom: don't auto-open the artifact dialog when loading an already-verified mission (modal overlay blocks the room).
Orchestrator: mark all specialist agents 'done' (or 'idle') on MISSION_VERIFIED instead of leaving them 'waiting'.
Optional: purge the legacy failed mission record and add aria-describedby to the artifact DialogContent.
critical_code_review_comments: orchestrator._seqs/_seq_locks are module-level in-memory dicts — event seq counters reset on backend restart and are not shared across workers; an in-flight mission after a reload would emit duplicate seq values. Consider deriving seq from a MongoDB counter or max(seq)+1.

orchestrator._run: if the execution wave loop hits a state where nothing is ready (cyclic/unsatisfiable dependencies), it silently `break`s and the mission still proceeds to REVIEW/VERIFIED with incomplete tasks. Should mark blocked tasks and fail/flag the mission.
provider._validate_plan uses bare asserts; fine for fallback control-flow but relies on assertions not being stripped (-O). Prefer explicit raises.
Credits deduction (users.$inc -credits) can go negative — no balance check before starting a mission even though a credits meter is surfaced in the UI.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 live-AI missions via API/UI (marketing x2, SaaS churn, habit tracker) — all reached verified; ~85 credits consumed from default-user.
test_credentials: N/A — app has no auth (single implicit default-user); /app/memory/test_credentials.md not present and not needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives in /app/backend/tests (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; lifecycle and dynamic-workforce classes each create real missions and poll up to 200s — a full run takes ~60s with live AI). Verified assertions: exactly one task with retry_count==1 and status 'verified', REVISION_REQUIRED(warning)+ISSUE_ROUTED(warning)+>=2 REVIEW_PASSED, PARALLEL_EXECUTION events, artifact.content with title/sections/recommendations, credits_used == tasks*3+6, no _id leaks. Frontend: after fixes, re-verify (1) all React Flow nodes visible without manual Fit View, (2) artifact dialog does NOT auto-open when entering a verified mission via /history, (3) specialist agent statuses after verification.
rca_of_the_issue: React Flow graph: MissionRoom fetches mission data after mount, so ReactFlow's one-shot `fitView` prop evaluates against an empty node set and the viewport keeps the default translate/scale(2); measured 6/8 nodes fully outside the pane, and clicking the native Fit View control restored scale 0.68 with 0 offscreen nodes. Artifact modal: MissionRoom's artifactShown ref opens the dialog on the first poll where status === 'verified', which is also true on initial load of an already-completed mission, so the modal (and its pointer-blocking overlay) appears before the user can inspect the room.
